digest.component_or_area: review-bot test fixtures and lifespan configuration
propositions: Review-bot ASGI lifespan tests inherit the production 1200-second shutdown queue-drain default, causing unit tests to hang or run long-duration background sweeps instead of completing quickly
Test harness must bind shutdown drain to 1.0 seconds globally and stub reconcile_loop and background janitor by default, while allowing opt-in to real reconciler via marker

Multiple test files contained duplicated or specialized string patches for reconciler and janitor mocking; identical setup must be de-duplicated into a module-autouse fixture while purpose-specific fakes are retained
Production DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS=1200 constant and shutdown_drain_seconds() config override must remain unchanged
Test-local SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS overrides must take precedence over the suite-wide 1.0 baseline
